stories.title: India blow moulded plastic packaging market analysis
stories.summary: India remains a major production hub for rigid plastic packaging, with PET bottles and HDPE containers dominating volume. Indicative empty-pack prices range from 1.5 to 4 rupees for a 500 ml PET bottle and 20 to 50 rupees for a 5 litre HDPE container. Prices vary by order size.

stories.title: Kataka municipal corporation seizes single-use plastic
stories.summary: The Kataka Municipal Corporation seized 1.5 quintals of prohibited single-use plastic during an enforcement drive on Friday. The civic body urged traders and residents to switch to eco-friendly alternatives to help make the city cleaner and more sustainable. The initiative remains ongoing across various city locations.

stories.title: Cologne brewers oppose proposed German taxes
stories.summary: The Cologne Brewery Association opposes proposed sugar and plastic taxes in Germany, arguing the measures add costs and administrative burdens to midsize producers already under economic strain. The trade group has joined a joint statement from numerous business associations calling for the two tax plans to be withdrawn.

stories.title: Sikkim authorities seize banned plastic items
stories.summary: Authorities confiscated 1.2 kg of banned single-use plastic and collected 2,000 rupees in fines during joint inspections across seven municipal areas in Sikkim on November 3. Shopkeepers were briefed on the Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016, which include prohibitions on items like plastic-stick ear buds.

stories.title: Nagaland University hosts anti-plastic programme
stories.summary: Nagaland University organised a programme on November 5 to discourage single-use plastics as part of the BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week. The event featured discussions on environmental impacts and aligned with the university's participation in the national Mission LiFE initiative to promote sustainable living habits among the public.

stories.title: APPCB conducts plastic awareness drives in Kurnool
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board organized awareness drives in Kurnool and Nandyal districts for BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week. Officials distributed cloth bags and administered the Meri LiFE pledge at local markets and hospitals, advising citizens to switch to reusable steel containers and wooden utensils instead of plastic.

stories.title: Puttaparthi launches plastic collection initiative
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board organized a single-use plastic awareness programme in Puttaparthi during BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week. The local District Collector inaugurated the drive and unveiled specialized plastic collection bins at Revenue Bhavan, urging the public to adopt reusable cloth bags and stop using single-use plastics.

stories.title: Kadapa hosts awareness programme on plastic use
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board organized an awareness programme at a local market in Kadapa on Thursday. Officials educated farmers and vendors on the harmful effects of single-use plastics and distributed cloth bags to encourage the adoption of eco-friendly habits during Sustainable Lifestyle Week.

stories.title: Nagaland University discusses plastic usage
stories.summary: Nagaland University held a programme on single-use plastics on Thursday as part of BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week. Faculty members noted that plastic usage surged in the 1950s and argued that the convenience of using items once creates a severe ecological imbalance that requires a shift in habits.

stories.title: Nagaland University marks sustainable lifestyle week
stories.summary: Nagaland University observed BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week with a programme on single-use plastics on November 5. The event highlighted the alignment between India’s 2026 BRICS Chairship and the objectives of Mission LiFE, focusing on the origins and environmental consequences of widespread disposable plastic use.

stories.title: Tripura market hosts plastic awareness seminar
stories.summary: The Tripura State Pollution Control Board and the Lions Club of Agartala organized an awareness seminar at Maharajganj Market on Thursday. The event focused on educating traders and citizens about the long-term environmental consequences of single-use plastic and promoted the vision of a cleaner, plastic-free Tripura.

stories.title: US polypropylene export prices edge lower
stories.summary: Polypropylene export prices in the United States have edged lower despite tight spot availability. The full report is available to subscribers of the service, which requires browser cookies to be enabled for authentication and access to the platform's market data and analysis.

stories.title: October resin prices increase
stories.summary: Major commodity resin prices saw increases in October 2026. Access to the full report on polyethylene, polystyrene, PVC, and polypropylene price trends is restricted to subscribers of the publication. The server currently denies access to the requested data page.

stories.title: India synthetic latex polymers market forecast
stories.summary: India's synthetic latex polymers market supplies binders for industries including paper, textiles, and construction. Demand is expected to grow 6 to 9 percent annually through 2035, potentially lifting market activity by 70 to 120 percent as industrial sectors continue to convert to water-based formulations.

stories.title: India monoethylene glycol market outlook
stories.summary: India's monoethylene glycol demand is anchored by the polyester industry, which absorbs roughly 70 to 85 percent of consumption. Bulk prices for 2026 are approximately 50 to 80 rupees per kg before taxes, with domestic production supplemented by imports covering 25 to 45 percent of the market.

stories.title: German opaque polymer market analysis
stories.summary: In Germany, opaque polymers are primarily used as aqueous opacifiers in waterborne paints to scatter light and improve hiding. Architectural coatings represent 60 to 75 percent of demand. These additives can sometimes allow titanium dioxide usage to fall by 5 to 15 percent in suitable paint formulations.

stories.title: Japan antimicrobial plastic market trends
stories.summary: Japan's antimicrobial plastic market is a specialty-compounding business driven by qualified parts and packaging. Polyethylene and polypropylene account for 45 to 60 percent of material volume. Market demand is projected to grow 5 to 8 percent annually through 2035, depending on future adoption rates by manufacturers.

stories.title: Global commodity plastics market enters 2026
stories.summary: The global commodity plastics market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture. The sector, which includes polyethylene, polypropylene, and PET, is navigating a transition as demand from the packaging, construction, and automotive industries continues to fuel forward growth.

stories.title: AdvanSix reports higher sales but lower earnings
stories.summary: AdvanSix reported third-quarter sales of $431 million, a 15% increase from a year earlier. Despite higher sales, the company reported an adjusted loss of $0.24 per share as raw material costs and reduced production weighed on profitability. The company is now planning an ammonia expansion with federal funding.

stories.title: Commodity chemicals outlook shifts toward polymers
stories.summary: Global demand for commodity chemicals is expected to rise through 2035, with growth driven by polymers for packaging and infrastructure. IndexBox notes that energy transition pressures and shifting production capacities will shape the market. Polymers remain the primary engine for growth in the sector.

stories.title: Nextloopp project targets food-grade polypropylene
stories.summary: Professor Edward Kosior, who won a 2020 sustainability award for the Nextloopp project, continues to work on creating food-grade packaging from recycled polypropylene. Polypropylene is the most widely used food-grade polymer, yet post-consumer packaging has historically been difficult to return to food contact products.

stories.title: EU backs harmonized end-of-waste rules for plastics
stories.summary: EU member states have voted in favor of harmonized end-of-waste criteria for recycled plastics to create a single market and reduce administrative costs. The criteria are expected to apply around mid-2027. Industry groups have welcomed the move while calling for further harmonization through the upcoming Circular Economy Act.

stories.title: Ganesha Ecosphere reports rPET capacity growth
stories.summary: Ganesha Ecosphere Limited reported that its FSSAI-approved rPET capacity reached 65,000 tonnes following the approval of its fourth Warangal line. Management expects rPET utilisation to reach 90% by the end of fiscal year 2027. The company estimated total Indian rPET sales at 25,000 to 50,000 tonnes monthly.

stories.title: Researchers develop plastic-to-adhesive recycling process
stories.summary: Researchers at ETH Zurich have developed a one-step chemical process to transform polyethylene and polypropylene waste into high-performance adhesives. The technique attaches new polymer chains to plastic waste rather than breaking the materials down. This approach aims to address the degradation of plastic quality during conventional recycling.

stories.title: Operation Clean Sweep expands to India
stories.summary: Operation Clean Sweep has launched OCS India to expand its resin stewardship program. Administered by the All India Plastics Manufacturers' Association, the program aims to keep plastic resin out of the environment. OCS now operates in 18 of the 24 countries that are top plastics importers and exporters.

stories.title: FSSAI proposes rules for recycled plastic in food packaging
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has proposed allowing chemically recycled polyethylene and polypropylene in food-contact packaging. The recycled material must meet safety criteria applicable to virgin plastics. The draft amendments also permit recycled plastic in the outer layers of multilayer packaging with adequate migration barriers.

stories.title: India moves to allow recycled plastic in food packaging
stories.summary: India is moving to allow wider use of recycled plastic in food packaging to help companies meet mandatory recycling targets. Under proposed draft rules, recycled plastic must meet the same safety standards as new plastic. The move aims to remove a regulatory hurdle for using recycled materials.

stories.title: Commentary | The true cost of SB 54 isn't on the shelf
stories.summary: California's Senate Bill 54 is changing how food and beverage companies account for packaging. By introducing extended producer responsibility (EPR) fees and mandatory source-reduction targets, the legislation places a financial value on material consumption that historically has received limited scrutiny beyond procurement and waste management.

stories.title: California considers fee delays for plastic packaging law
stories.summary: California lawmakers have discussed delaying certain fees under Senate Bill 54 for 2026 and 2027. While the delay could provide temporary financial relief, the law's requirement for extensive collection and production of packaging material data remains in effect. Data collection is not delayed.

stories.title: CalRecycle updates SB 54 source reduction baseline
stories.summary: California’s Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery (CalRecycle) has updated its source reduction baseline as the state’s extended producer responsibility (EPR) law for packaging, Senate Bill 54, inches closer to its launch date. The law is scheduled to take effect Jan. 1, 2027. One of

stories.title: Scotland consults on national recycling framework
stories.summary: The Scottish Government is consulting on a national framework for household recycling to improve service consistency. Officials claim the changes could increase recycling rates by 2.5 percent and cut carbon emissions by 50,000 tonnes annually. The plan aims to ensure recycling does not depend on where you live.

stories.summary: Minister of State for Climate Change Dr Shezra Mansab Ali Khan Kharal has urged the government and private sector to develop a coordinated national framework for Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), improve waste sorting and invest in recycling facilities to curb plastic pollution. stories.summary: CalRecycle has finalized the source reduction baseline for Senate Bill 54. The figure is one-third of what the state estimated in 2024 and 20 percent lower than industry projections from June. Producers must cut single-use plastic weight by 25 percent by 2032, starting from this new number.

stories.title: Sonoco’s GreenCan® GEN2: making noise in paper packaging
stories.summary: As paper-based packaging gains ground across new markets, Sonoco is taking its established GreenCan® concept a step further. With an innovative closure that delivers an audible “pop”, stronger reclosure and greater design possibilities, the second generation shows just how far the paper can has come.

stories.title: Mondi introduces bio-based flexible pouch
stories.summary: Mondi has launched a flexible packaging pouch containing at least 98 percent bio-based polyethylene derived from sugarcane. The company says the material replaces conventional fossil-based plastics in food and personal care packaging. The product is designed to meet performance requirements while incorporating renewable feedstock into the pouch structure.

stories.title: CTI brings paperboard canisters to North American market
stories.summary: Indiana-based Combined Technologies, Inc. is offering Graphic Packaging's Boardio paperboard canisters to nutraceutical brands. The move provides an alternative to rigid plastic bottles and tubs for capsules and powders. The canisters are made primarily from paperboard and include barrier options to limit oxygen and moisture exposure.

stories.title: Kerala printer buys flatbed cutter to speed up box production
stories.summary: Change Digital Printers in Kerala has purchased a Bindwel SigLoch XE-CUT digital flatbed cutting table. The company, which specializes in commercial printing, says it chose the machine for its quality and its made-in-India status to help fast-track its short-run carton box-making capacity.

stories.title: Automatic label dispenser market enters 2026 with new demand
stories.summary: The global automatic label dispenser market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals, more disciplined procurement behavior, and a more regionally diversified supply architecture, according to a new IndexBox report. The market now balances replacement demand in mature economies with greenfield investments in emerging industrial corridors.

stories.title: Plastic bag machine market faces structural transition
stories.summary: The global plastic bag making machines market is entering a period of structural transition through 2035, according to IndexBox. Historically anchored in high-volume, low-cost production, the industry now operates at the intersection of entrenched packaging demand and accelerating environmental regulation.

stories.title: Krones launches compact packer with crate flow reversal
stories.summary: Krones has launched a compact Varioline 1M packer that reverses crate flow by 180 degrees without sacrificing production speed. The machine handles up to 103,000 containers per hour. Krombacher Brauerei has ordered the first two units for its ongoing packaging line modernization.

stories.title: Yangi adds undercut feature to dry-molded fiber platform
stories.summary: Yangi is introducing an undercut feature for its Cellera industrial dry-forming platform to enable complex functional geometries in molded fiber packaging. The company says the innovation expands the possibilities for replacing conventional plastic packaging by allowing for reliable mechanical fits between lids and containers.

stories.title: MBO introduces automated paper-based packaging system
stories.summary: Post-press specialist MBO has introduced WrapXi, an automated end-of-line packaging system that wraps finished products in kraft paper. The company says the system reduces manual handling and provides a paper-based alternative to plastic wrapping for printers and finishers.

stories.title: Zemeijia completes corrugated box trial for biotech client
stories.summary: Zemeijia has completed trial production of a custom corrugated box for a Brazilian biotechnology customer. The project features ventilation holes and E-flute board. The company says the trial highlights its ability to develop packaging around specific shipping needs before bulk purchasing.

stories.title: Miraclon showcases flexographic plates at LOUPE India
stories.summary: Miraclon showcased its Flexcel Prime flexographic plate at LOUPE India 2026. Regional director Andy Yarrow stated the company’s approach centers on process standardization and consistency. The company noted that some customers are currently trying to print flexo like gravure.

stories.title: Hosokawa Alpine expands winder portfolio with AWX series
stories.summary: Hosokawa Alpine has launched its AWX series of winders for blown film production. The company says the modular design offers maximum design freedom and can be precisely tailored to individual customer requirements to make production processes efficient and future-proof.

stories.title: Prompt targets growth in packaging automation
stories.summary: Prompt is targeting five-fold growth in its weighing and packaging business as demand for automation increases across India. The Gujarat-based group, which has a 30-year legacy in dairy technology, showcased its automated manufacturing solutions at Anuga FoodTec India 2026.

stories.title: Blister card packaging market evolves toward automation
stories.summary: The global blister card packaging market is entering a phase of structural evolution as demand shifts toward higher-barrier, sustainability-compliant, and automation-ready formats, according to IndexBox. Blister cards remain a preferred solution where product visibility, tamper evidence, and unit-dose integrity are critical.

stories.title: Hot fill packaging market projected to reach $16.5 billion
stories.summary: The global hot fill packaging market was valued at $12.2 billion in 2025 and is expected to reach $16.5 billion by 2034, according to Prismane Consulting. Growth is driven by increasing adoption across food and beverage applications and demand for convenient, shelf-stable products.

stories.title: Tuck top box market projected to reach $5.16 billion
stories.summary: The global tuck top box market is projected to reach $5.16 billion by 2035, growing at a 4.8% CAGR. Market growth is driven by demand for sustainable paper-based packaging, the expansion of e-commerce, and the need for lightweight, cost-efficient folding cartons.

stories.title: Food delivery industry impacts packaging ecosystem
stories.summary: India’s food delivery industry has created an extensive business ecosystem connecting restaurants, cloud kitchens, and technology platforms. The sector has changed how millions access food, creating new opportunities for packaging suppliers and local food entrepreneurs in the process.

stories.title: Beverage cups market undergoes structural realignment
stories.summary: The global beverage cups market is undergoing a structural realignment as regulatory pressure and shifting consumer expectations redefine competition, according to IndexBox. The market is bifurcating into two parallel supply chains: high-performance recyclable single-use cups and reusable systems supported by washing infrastructure.

stories.title: Fast food bag market transforms with delivery boom
stories.summary: The global fast food bag market is entering a phase of structural transformation shaped by the rise of off-premise dining and third-party delivery, according to IndexBox. Fast food bags are no longer commoditized afterthoughts but critical components of brand experience and logistics.

stories.title: Clamshell packaging market shaped by conflicting forces
stories.summary: The global clamshell packaging market is shaped by the relentless growth in e-commerce, demand for premium product presentation, and stringent safety regulations, according to IndexBox. The market remains a mature yet dynamic segment of the protective packaging industry.

stories.title: Paper tube market outlook for 2035
stories.summary: IndexBox reports the global paper tube market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals, more disciplined procurement behavior, and a more regionally diversified supply architecture. The market is described as a critical yet often understated segment of the industrial packaging landscape. It remains essential for various manufacturing sectors.

stories.title: Edge protector market trends for 2035
stories.summary: The global paper plastic edge protector market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals, more disciplined procurement behavior, and a more regionally diversified supply architecture. These hybrid solutions safeguard goods during transport. Demand is shaped by sustainability mandates, material innovation, and the ongoing pressure to keep costs down.

stories.title: AltM raises $10.3 million for agricultural waste chemicals
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has closed a $10.3 million Series A round to expand manufacturing capacity. The company aims to reduce dependence on fossil-based feedstocks by using agricultural residues. The capital will support plant expansion and operational requirements as Indian chemical makers face pressure to cut emissions.

stories.title: Silgan secures lender consent for packaging transaction
stories.summary: Silgan has modified its credit agreement to facilitate the contribution of specific metal and plastic packaging businesses to MetalCo. The consent allows MetalCo to be designated as an unrestricted subsidiary and permits the use of proceeds that would otherwise prepay loans to redeem specified senior notes.

stories.title: CJK Group acquires Viking Label & Packaging
stories.summary: CJK Group has acquired Viking Label & Packaging. The full piece is for subscribers of Label & Narrow Web magazine, which covers industry news and developments. The acquisition marks another consolidation within the European label and narrow web sector, where converters continue to pursue growth and technical innovation.

stories.title: Ball Corporation reports Q3 sales of $4.19 billion
stories.summary: Ball Corporation reported third-quarter 2026 sales of $4.19 billion, up from $3.38 billion a year ago. Despite a 4.7 percent increase in global aluminum packaging shipments, the company recorded a GAAP net loss of $94 million. Higher earnings were reported on a non-GAAP basis.

stories.title: Paras Semiconductors partners with BroadPak for packaging
stories.summary: Paras Semiconductors has partnered with US-based BroadPak Corporation to develop advanced semiconductor packaging in India. The collaboration combines manufacturing ambitions in opto-electronics and photonics with specialized expertise in chiplet-based system architectures. The companies aim to accelerate the development of heterogeneous integration capabilities within the domestic market.

stories.title: Biffa to acquire Enva recycling businesses
stories.summary: Biffa is set to acquire Enva recycling operations in Scotland and England, handling an estimated 800,000 tonnes of waste annually. The deal includes 150 vehicles and 600 staff members. Financial terms remain undisclosed, with contract completion expected in December. The waste continues to arrive regardless of the owner.

stories.title: Mold-Tek Packaging profit rises 36 percent
stories.summary: Mold-Tek Packaging reported a 36.06 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 21.07 crore rupees for Q2FY27. While pharma volume grew 26.3 percent, paint packaging volume growth of 8.61 percent trailed the company's annual guidance. The company expects its new joint venture to contribute significant revenue within two years.

stories.title: Logson Group acquires Playford Packaging
stories.summary: Logson Group has acquired Wrexham-based Playford Packaging, marking the company's entry into the Welsh market. The existing management team will remain to lead the site as a stand-alone business within the group. Logson Group is currently the largest independent manufacturer of corrugated packaging in the UK.

stories.title: TCPL Packaging reports 59 percent profit growth
stories.summary: TCPL Packaging reported a 59.2 percent year-on-year increase in standalone net profit to 45.09 crore rupees for the second quarter of FY27. Consolidated revenue grew 20.2 percent to 564.61 crore rupees. The company also incorporated a new subsidiary to focus on battery separator films.

stories.title: Riverside Company invests in Hoover Circular Solutions
stories.summary: The Riverside Company has invested in specialty packaging rental provider Hoover Circular Solutions. Further details regarding the transaction are currently unavailable due to access restrictions on the source server. The investment follows broader trends in industrial packaging and circular economy services within the logistics and supply chain sector.

stories.title: EPL profit rises 4 percent
stories.summary: EPL reported a net profit of 111 crore rupees for the September quarter, a 4 percent increase from the previous year. Revenue grew 30 percent to 1,567.4 crore rupees. Profit growth was impacted by higher depreciation costs and tax rates, despite strong underlying performance across core business categories.
